description: Measures creatinine, a waste product filtered by the kidneys, used to assess kidney function.
Thyroid Stimulating Hormone regulates thyroid gland activity; used to screen thyroid function.
Bicarbonate reflects the body's acid-base (pH) balance, part of the basic metabolic panel.
An enzyme mainly found in the liver; elevated levels can indicate liver cell damage.
Blood sugar level measured after fasting; used to screen for diabetes/prediabetes.
An enzyme found in the liver and muscles; elevated levels can indicate tissue damage.
White blood cell count; part of the complete blood count, reflects immune/infection status.
Platelets are blood cells involved in clotting; counts outside range may indicate bleeding or clotting risk.
Red blood cell count; reflects oxygen-carrying capacity of the blood.
A type of fat in the blood; elevated levels are linked to cardiovascular risk.
An electrolyte critical for fluid balance and nerve/muscle function.
Reflects the body's vitamin D stores; used to screen for deficiency.
'Bad' cholesterol; elevated levels are associated with cardiovascular disease risk.
Estimates how well the kidneys filter blood; used to assess kidney function/stage of disease.
